svg.text: Tn5 cuts the target 9 nt apart on the two strands and joins one strand of each end
1. target DNA: the two cuts are staggered
2. after cutting: the adapter (transferred strand) sits on the 5' end only
3. at 72 °C a polymerase fills the gap from the free 3'-OH, leftwards
The ME end (orange) is shown with the standard 19 nt. A gap, not a nick: it needs a polymerase, not a ligase.
